name: After § 61
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 61 a. Stresses the importance of a coordinated and comprehensive approach to combating organised crime across the Union, with a view to preventing its infiltration into the legal economy; recalls, in this context, that the fight against corruption constitutes a key element in mitigating such risks; calls, therefore, for adequate allocations under the Internal Security Fund to be devoted to anti-corruption measures within the Member States;
